Name: Remote Fridge Storage - Use cooking ingredients from chests
Author: arjan3004
Description:
[size=5]Description
[size=3]Allows you to marks chest for storing your cooking ingredients instead of storing it all in the fridge. When you use the counter to start cooking it will look through all ingredient chest and take the items automatically out of the chests when crafting.

[/size]Installation[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip this mod into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][size=5]Usage
[size=3]Place a chest anywhere in the world and click the fridge icon to mark it as an ingredient chest.[/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/2545/2545-1533757113-75967091.gif[/img]﻿
[/size]
Additionally you can change the location of the icon in game by holding the right mouse button while hovering over the icon, and moving the mouse.

[size=4][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/size][list]
[*][size=4][size=3] Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/518]Chests Anywhere[/url]﻿ [Confirmed for 1.5.4 & 1.6][/size][/size]
[*][size=4][size=3] Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/522/?tab=description]Cooking Skill[/url] [size=4][size=3] [Confirmed for 1.5.4][/size][/size][/size][/size]
[*][size=4][size=3] Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6830]Love Of Cooking[/url]﻿[size=4][size=3] [Confirmed for 1.5.4][/size][/size][/size][/size]
[*][size=4][size=3] Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1191]Expanded Fridge[/url] [/size][/size]
[*][size=4][size=3] Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2196?tab=description]Convenient Chests[/url][/size][/size][size=4][size=3] [size=4][size=3] [Confirmed for 1.5.4][/size][/size] (you will still be able to cook from unmarked chests if they are close the fridge)[/size][/size]
[*][size=4][size=3] Integration with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] [1.5.4 ONLY][/size][/size]
[size=4][size=3]﻿
[/size][/size][*][size=4][size=3] May be incompatible with mods that make changes to cooking or chests.[/size][/size]
[/list][list]
[/list][size=5]
Multiplayer[/size]

The mod works in multiplayer but the selected changes are not synchronized and they are not saved for the farm hands.

[size=5]Uninstalling
[size=3]Make sure all chests are unmarked for usage by the fridge and you saved the game. Then delete the RemoteFridgeStorage folder.[/size][/size]

[size=4]For Mod Authors
[/size][size=3]Simple interface to get [/size][size=4][size=3]all marked chests.
[/size][/size][code]﻿﻿public interface IRemoteFridgeApi
{
﻿IEnumerable<Chest> GetFridgeChests();
}
﻿ISomeModApi api = helper.ModRegistry.GetApi<ISomeModApi>("[size=4][size=3]EternalSoap.RemoteFridgeStorage[/size][/size]");[/code]
